signIn: Sign in with your CRC music editor account to review family sharing.
title: Review family sharing
intro: Choose the source rows, practice directions, and authorized files the assigned family may use. Private performance notes stay in the music setlist.
openFromPortal: Open a ceremony’s sharing review from Beit Mitzvah to see its service here.
scheduleReview: The schedule needs review. Update the music setlist to {date}, {type}, then confirm the retained link.
approvalNotice: Saving replaces the previous sharing approval. Select each row and file deliberately. A changed arrangement or text requires another review.
empty: This source setlist has no rows yet. Add the ceremony music in the setlist, then load it again.
audioShare: Share this row’s source reference audio (MP3 only)
rights: Permission or license covering these selected files for the assigned family
rightsNotice: Having a file in the music library does not establish permission to share it.
stale: The music changed. Refresh the service before approving.
scheduleMismatch: Update the date and service type in the music setlist first, then confirm the schedule here.
manifestRequired: A selected file needs an exact source catalog hash and Storage generation before it can be shared.
unconfigured: The music connection has not been configured.
failed: The action could not be completed. Check your music access and refresh the service.
withdrawn: Sharing withdrawn. New family requests for these rows and files are blocked.
scheduleConfirmed: Schedule confirmed. Refresh the service to review what families can see.
saved: Review saved. Only the selected rows and files are shared with the assigned ceremony.
